Soveværelse

Z6 · 17.8° · 0 % open · Motor fault

Motor fault: end-stop timeout

The motor did not reach the end stop within 45 s. The valve is held closed. Check the actuator, then reset the fault.

Before you reset: 1) The actuator sits fully down on the valve and is not tilted. 2) The cable is fully in its socket. 3) The valve pin can move. 4) Look at where the valve stands and choose it below.

Did the motor run too far?

Run for

Drive the motor back, away from the direction it faulted in. If it pushed too far, the plunger comes back up. The end stop is still armed, and the zone stays blocked until you reset the fault.

Reset the fault

The valve is

On a normally open (NO) manifold the valve is closed when the plunger is pressed down. Closed and open are used as a known starting point, so V6 can move from there without re-homing. Middle and not sure re-home towards closed first.
